CISF Constable Result 2025 Out

The CISF Constable CBT Result 2025 has been released online in PDF format, allowing candidates to easily check their status by searching their Name or Roll Number in the CISF Constable Merit List 2025. The CISF Recruitment Result 2025 has been announced zone-wise to ensure fair and transparent shortlisting for all applicants. Candidates who have successfully qualified in the CBT round will now be called for the next stages of the selection process, which include Document Verification and a Medical Examination. These upcoming stages are crucial as they will determine the final selection of candidates for the CISF Constable post.

CISF Constable Result 2025 Download Link

Candidates can easily access the CISF Constable Result 2025 download link from the official website. To make it simpler, we have also shared the direct result PDF link below. Just click on the link, open the PDF, and search your name or roll number in the merit list. Make sure to save a copy for future verification.

Direct Link to Download CISF Constable Result 2025 PDF

CISF Constable Result 2025: Overview

How To Download CISF Constable Result PDF?

Candidates can follow the simple steps given below to check the CISF Constable CBT Result 2025:

  1. Visit the official website: cisf.gov.in
  2. Click on the Recruitment section.
  3. Find and click on CISF Constable Result 2025.
  4. Open the CISF Result PDF.
  5. Use Ctrl+F to search your Roll Number / Name.
  6. Save and print the result for future verification.

Details Mentioned On CISF Constable Result 2025

The CISF Constable Result PDF contains the following details:

  • Candidate Name
  • Roll Number
  • Category (UR/OBC/SC/ST)
  • Post Name (Constable)
  • Exam Session
  • Qualification Status
  • Instructions for further process

What Next After CISF Constable Result 2025 Declaration?

Candidates who find their names in the CISF Constable Merit List 2025 must now prepare for the Document Verification & Medical Test. This is a crucial phase as candidates must fulfill the medical fitness standards required for the Constable post.Only candidates who pass the medical examination will be included in the final CISF Constable Selection List 2025.

CISF Constable Cut Off 2025

The CISF Constable Cut Off 2025 is the minimum score required to qualify for the next stage of the recruitment process. Candidates who score equal to or above the CISF Constable Cut Off 2025 in the CBT exam are shortlisted for Document Verification and the Medical Test. Candidates can check the table given below for complete cut off for CISF Constable 2025.

CISF Constable Cut Off
Category Cut Off Marks (Out of 100)
General (UR) 72 – 78
OBC 68 – 74
SC 60 – 66
ST 55 – 62

 Yes, the CISF Constable merit list has been released zone-wise.
